title: What Are You Doing?

vocabulary.imageAlt: One woman working on a laptop.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.translation: Oi! O que você está fazendo?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: I'm cooking dinner. What about you?
dialogue.translation: Estou preparando o jantar. E você?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: Nice! Do you usually watch movies at night?
dialogue.translation: Legal! Você costuma assistir a filmes à noite?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Yes, but I usually read before bed. Do you cook every day?
dialogue.translation: Sim, mas geralmente leio antes de dormir. Você cozinha todos os dias?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: Not really. I usually order food, but today I'm making pasta.
dialogue.translation: Na verdade, não. Geralmente peço comida, mas hoje estou fazendo macarrão.

mimeInstructions: One person acts out an activity without speaking.
The other person guesses what they're doing using the Present Continuous.
After guessing correctly, ask one question about the person's routine.

mimeExample.speaker: A
mimeExample.text: Do you brush your teeth after breakfast?

mimeExample.speaker: B
mimeExample.text: Yes, I do! I brush my teeth every morning.

homework.title: Real-Life Observation
homework.mission: Your Mission: What Are People Doing?
homework.description: Go to a public place, such as a café, shopping mall or park. Observe what people around you are doing and record a short audio describing their activities.
homework.example: I'm at a café. A woman is drinking coffee. Two people are talking. A man is working on his laptop.
instructions: Record a short audio using the Present Continuous.
Send the audio to your teacher.
homework.note: You only need an audio description. You do not need to film or photograph anyone.
